planPhases.title: Create AuthContext (src/context/AuthContext.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created src/context/AuthContext.tsx. Initialises token/user from localStorage, exposes login() and logout(), exports AuthProvider and useAuthContext. All base tests still pass; auth test failures are from later phases (missing LoginPage/SignupPage).

planPhases.title: Create LoginPage (src/pages/LoginPage.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/LoginPage.tsx. Posts to http://localhost:3001/auth/login. On 200: calls login() and navigates to /. On 401/error: shows fixed string 'Invalid email or password'. Submit button is disabled while loading. All 4 authLogin.test.tsx tests pass. Build fails due to missing SignupPage (phase-3 pre-existing issue).

planPhases.title: Create SignupPage (src/pages/SignupPage.tsx)
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/SignupPage.tsx. Posts to http://localhost:3001/auth/signup. Client-side password mismatch shows 'Passwords do not match' without calling fetch. On 201: calls login() and navigates to /. On 409: shows server's error.message. On 400 with details array: shows first details[0].message. Submit button disabled while loading. All 6 authSignup.test.tsx tests pass. Build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Update NavBar to show auth state
planPhases.notes: Updated src/components/NavBar.tsx to consume useAuthContext(). Logged out: shows Sign Up and Log In links. Logged in: shows username text and Log Out button that calls logout() and navigates to /login. Also added AuthProvider import and wrapper to App.tsx (minimal prerequisite so existing tests that render App still pass — routes left for phase-6). All 3 authNavBar tests pass; all 31 existing tests pass; build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Update productsApi to attach JWT header
planPhases.notes: Updated src/api/productsApi.ts to read localStorage.getItem('auth_token') before each fetch. If present, uses 'Bearer <token>'; if absent, falls back to 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024'. Both authProductsApiToken tests pass. Build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Wire AuthProvider and new routes in App.tsx
planPhases.notes: Added imports for LoginPage and SignupPage. Added <Route path='login' element={<LoginPage />}> and <Route path='signup' element={<SignupPage />}> as sibling routes outside AppLayout. AuthProvider was already wrapping the tree from phase-4. All 32 tests pass; build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run tests and verify all task12 visible tests pass
planPhases.notes: All 32 tests pass (10 test files): authProductsApiToken (2), authNavBar (3), app.render (1), loadingError (4), clearFilters (1), sorting (3), pagination (5), authLogin (4), filtering (3), authSignup (6). Build also succeeds with no TypeScript errors.

planPhases.title: Add 004_users.sql migration
planPhases.notes: Create src/benchmark-backend/src/db/migrations/004_users.sql with the users table (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))). The migrate.ts runner picks up all *.sql files sorted alphabetically, so naming is sufficient — no code changes needed.

planPhases.title: Create authSchema.ts with Zod schemas
planPhases.notes: Create src/benchmark-backend/src/schemas/authSchema.ts. Export registerSchema (z.object with email: z.string().email(), username: z.string().min(1), password: z.string().min(8)) and loginSchema (z.object with email and password). Follow the pattern in src/schemas/favouriteSchema.ts.

planPhases.title: Create authService.ts (register, login, getById)
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/services/authService.ts with register(), login(), getById(). Added bcrypt and jsonwebtoken (plus @types) to package.json and ran pnpm install --offline (packages were already in .pnpm store). Build passes. Auth tests all 404 as expected since routes/controllers are not yet wired up (phases 4-6). Existing product tests still pass (20/20).

planPhases.title: Create requireJwt.ts middleware
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/middleware/requireJwt.ts. Extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, verifies with jsonwebtoken using JWT_SECRET (falls back to 'default-dev-secret' if env var not set). On success, attaches decoded payload to req.jwtPayload. On missing/invalid/expired token, responds 401 { error: 'Unauthorized' }. Also added jwtPayload?: { userId: string; email: string; username: string } to src/types/express.d.ts. Build passes. Test failures are 404s from routes not yet mounted (phases 5-6 still open).

planPhases.title: Create authController.ts (register, login, me handlers)
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/controllers/authController.ts with registerHandler (201 { user, token }), loginHandler (200 { user, token }), and meHandler (200 safe user). All read from req.validated (set by validate middleware). meHandler reads userId from req.jwtPayload. Errors propagate via next(err). Build passes.

planPhases.title: Create authRoutes.ts and mount at /api/auth in app.ts
planPhases.notes: Created src/benchmark-backend/src/routes/authRoutes.ts with POST /register (validate+registerHandler), POST /login (validate+loginHandler), GET /me (requireJwt+meHandler). Added authRoutes import to app.ts and mounted at /api/auth before the 404 catch-all. All 34 tests pass (including 14 auth tests), build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run tests and verify all auth tests pass
planPhases.notes: All 34 tests pass (2 test files: products and auth), build succeeds (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json). No changes required — previous phases had already wired everything correctly.
